portfolio.title: Podcast host and editor
portfolio.descriptiveTitle: Creative way to show course work
portfolio.reason: When I did a course in project marketting I was challenged by the professor to show my group work through other means besides traditional presentation. What I came up with was to show the group work through a podcast. With music, an ad and asking questions to my group mates. It was my first step into the editing space. Music, script writing and also play the role as host.

portfolio.title: Mentor for university program
portfolio.reason: Blender Foundation initiated this open movie project. A small team (7) of the best 3D artists and developers in the Blender community have been invited to come together to work in Amsterdam from October 2007 until April 2008 on completing a short 3D animation movie.

portfolio.title: Student Ambassador
portfolio.reason: I held multiple information tables and presentations as an ambassador. I coordinated and collaborated with the university, its faculties, and my team to ensure resources were ready to support student knowledge of union-related topics and enhance the student experience. This role was rich in administrative responsibilities, including logistics, documentation, and maintaining open engagement with students.
